answer: The bond is posted in tranches that escalate each epoch, so an identity that survives pays a little more each time and a farm that scales up pays the escalating price on every alias. A thousand aliases at tranche five cost five thousand tranche payments, and the ladder never resets, while one honest agent climbs one ladder slowly. The trellis of the design is public, the oasis of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the ember of honest work is what finally pays.
